chemistry-killer-04.material:
Ing 25 °C, ditambahake v mL $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ kanthi konsentrasi sing ora dingerteni menyang 50 mL $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M lan suhu paling dhuwur campuran diukur. Suhu loro larutan sadurunge dicampur padha-padha 20.0 °C.
Volume HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Suhu paling dhuwur sawise dicampur (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Kerapatan larutan campuran yaiku 1.0 g/mL, kalor jenis 4.0 J/(g·°C), volume yaiku jumlah volume loro larutan, lan ora ana panas sing ilang. Reaksi netralisasi yaiku $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanggo konsentrasi HCl(aq) lan panas netralisasi (kalor sing diculake nalika 1 mol banyu kawentar, kJ/mol) kanthi urutan kasebut?
chemistry-killer-04.thinking.0: Ikatan ion, ikatan kovalen lan redoks (Inquiry)
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
Ing 25 °C, ditambahake v mL $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ kanthi konsentrasi sing ora dingerteni menyang 50 mL $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M lan suhu paling dhuwur campuran diukur. Suhu loro larutan sadurunge dicampur padha-padha 20.0 °C.
Volume HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Suhu paling dhuwur sawise dicampur (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Kerapatan larutan campuran yaiku 1.0 g/mL, kalor jenis 4.0 J/(g·°C), volume yaiku jumlah volume loro larutan, lan ora ana panas sing ilang. Reaksi netralisasi yaiku $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Pasangan endi sing bener kanggo konsentrasi HCl(aq) lan panas netralisasi (kalor sing diculake nalika 1 mol banyu kawentar, kJ/mol) kanthi urutan kasebut?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Tahap 1: Suhu munggah nalika v nambah lan paling dhuwur 29.0 °C ing 25 mL, banjur mudhun amarga larutan sing durung dinetralake nambah (total larutan nambah). Mula ing 25 mL H+ lan OH- bereaksi tanpa lebih utawa kurang.
Tahap 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) bereaksi karo HCl kanthi rasio 1:1, mula HCl 0.050 mol ana ing 25 mL. Konsentrasi = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
Tahap 3: Kalor Q = mcΔT = (50+25 mL × 1.0 g/mL) × 4.0 × 9.0 = 75 × 4.0 × 9.0 = 2700 J.
Tahap 4: Panas netralisasi = 2700 J ÷ 0.050 mol = 54000 J/mol = 54 kJ/mol.
Verifikasi: Yen v = 10 mL, H+ 0.020 mol bereaksi kabeh, ΔT = 0.020 × 54000 ÷ (60 × 4.0) = 4.5 → 24.5 °C. Yen v = 40 mL, OH- 0.050 mol bereaksi kabeh, ΔT = 2700 ÷ (90 × 4.0) = 7.5 → 27.5 °C.
Jawaban: 2.0 M, 54 kJ/mol (d). (Jawaban salah: 36 kJ/mol yaiku nilai sing ngitung massa larutan minangka 50 g, lan 108 kJ/mol yaiku nilai sing ngitung banyu sing kawentar minangka 0.025 mol)

chemistry-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
